sentence: In hotels and resorts, leader narcissism shapes how the adoption factors translate into competitive positioning
passage: [Chakraborty (2025), abstract] "This study examines the use of Generative AI (GAI) in the hospitality industry, particularly in hotels and resorts." / "this study further explains how narcissism moderates the relationship between the factors that assist in adopting GAI and GAI's moderating effect on the overall competitive positioning and organisational outcomes."

gemini.note: The passage confirms that narcissism shapes how adoption factors affect competitive positioning, but does not specify that it is specifically 'leader' narcissism.
